title: AI That Can See Your Screen and Answer Questions (2026)
summary: VoiceOS is an AI that reads your screen and answers questions. On Mac or Windows, point or draw with your mouse cursor to show it exactly what you mean.
body_markdown:
### What is an AI that reads your screen?


An AI that reads your screen is a screen-aware, multimodal assistant that uses the visible screen as context. It can recognize text, app layouts, charts, buttons, images, and error messages, then answer questions about what it sees. VoiceOS brings that capability to Mac and Windows and lets you ask by voice instead of uploading screenshots to a separate chat.


### Is there an AI that can see my screen and answer questions?


Yes. VoiceOS can see your current screen and answer questions about it on Mac and Windows. Turn on “Point and ask about your screen,” hold the Agent Mode trigger, and ask about whatever is visible. It is an AI that sees your screen and answers questions based on the real page, app, chart, document, or error in front of you.


### How is this different from a chatbot like ChatGPT?


A standard chatbot lives in its own window and only knows what you type into it, so to get help you have to describe your screen in words. A screen-aware voice assistant closes that gap. It can see your screen with your permission, so it already knows the context, and it works system-wide across your apps instead of inside a single tab. You talk, it looks, it helps, with no copy-pasting and no explaining.


### What can an AI that scans your screen do?


Common uses include learning unfamiliar software without watching a tutorial, getting un-stuck the instant you cannot find a setting, understanding dense dashboards or documents, decoding confusing error messages, and turning "how do I do this?" into an action the assistant performs for you. With VoiceOS you can also dictate and edit text by voice and run multi-step tasks across apps like Gmail, Slack, and Google Calendar.


### Is it always watching my screen? What about privacy?


No. A well-designed screen-aware assistant should look only when you ask it to, not record continuously. VoiceOS looks at your screen on demand, when you invoke it, rather than constantly capturing in the background, and it asks for confirmation before taking important actions. You stay in control of when it sees your screen and what happens next.


### What is the best screen-aware voice assistant for Mac and Windows in 2026?


VoiceOS is one of the best options in 2026 because it is built for regular people, not just developers. It works system-wide on both Mac and Windows, understands natural language, sees your screen when you ask, and needs no setup, API keys, or coding. Backed by Y Combinator, it combines screen-aware questions, dictation, voice editing, and agent actions in a single app you can start using in minutes.


### Do I need to be technical to use one?


No. VoiceOS is designed for everyone, especially people who are new to AI. There is no code to write and no configuration to learn. You download it, grant permission, and start talking to your computer about whatever is on your screen.


### Can the assistant understand what I am pointing at with my cursor?


Yes. With “Point and ask about your screen” enabled, hold your Agent Mode trigger and move the mouse cursor while you speak. VoiceOS draws a blue trail, so you can point to one item or circle a region and ask about “this” or “that.” The marked screen and your words are read together, which is often much faster than describing the location.
